rule.name: FixedPortInTest
rule.message: This test binds a fixed port, so it fails when the port is taken: by a second run of the suite, a parallel test worker, an application running on the machine or a socket of the previous test that is still closing. Ask for a free port and read the one the server got: port 0 for a socket or HttpServer, RANDOM_PORT with @LocalServerPort for Spring Boot (DEFINED_PORT with a server.port number is reported), dynamicPort() for WireMock (@WireMockTest without httpPort), start() without a port for MockWebServer, @EmbeddedKafka without ports, and getMappedPort() for a container.
